parsed.snippet:
# @austinvhuang
I’m working on a little something to make GPU programming and kernel hacking more accessible to more people.
Will have something to share in about a week. 🤫
> Quote from @hyhieu226:
> CUDA is hard. But the mental barrier into it is more horrible.
Many times I've heard "NVIDIA has thousands of kernel engineers. Just use PyTorch."
If @tri_dao let that barrier stop him, today we wouldn't have FlashAttention.
Follow your curiosity. Learn. There is no limit.
